owner_and_capability: Fourth slice of #4076 across Student Presence, Communication and Delivery Platform: Student Presence announces changes through its own EventPublisher port and recognises duplicate sessions and visits in its Postgres adapter; Communication reads student access and fingerprints through ports the root binds to securityruntime; Delivery keeps its own setting key and permission names (pinned against the registries).
affected_tables: None: no DDL or table ownership change.
atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. Student Presence: LiveVisitChange, LiveSessionChange and LiveAttendanceDetail in its public vocabulary; api.PresenceEvents builds the SSE events (moved from delivery realtimeevents/presence.go); the Postgres adapter maps duplicate activity sessions and open visits to ErrActivitySessionExists and ErrOpenVisitExists; presence keeps its own not-found marker check. Communication: StudentReadAccess and Fingerprints ports bound by api.StaffStudentReads and api.SecurityFingerprints; communicationtest helpers move to api. Delivery: NewPreferenceService and NewEmailRecipientResolver take a PermissionMatch bound to securityruntime.HasPermission. Four stale rules are deleted; budgets only fall.
tests: Student Presence, Communication and Delivery suites keep their assertions; registry pins check the copied setting keys and permission names; the audit adapter tests moved to api.
scripts/run-go-toolchain.sh scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check; validate-ticket --all.
